Inoltre, Per poter inquadrare il problema prova a fornire queste informazioni:

  1. Versione di Thunderbird
  2. Versione del sistema operativo
  3. Provider delle caselle email (Gmail, Libero, Hotmail, etc.)
  4. Tipologia di account (POP3, IMAP)
  5. Estensioni installate
  6. Messaggi di errore che vengono visualizzati durante l'utilizzo di Thunderbird
  7. Software di sicurezza eventualmente presenti (Antivirus e simili)
  8. Screenshot del problema (se utile a chiarire il contesto)

On further investigation it is possible that this behaviour is due to automatic Thunderbird updates? It seems there is something installed called the Mozilla Maintenance system that would automatically apply updates in the background. So although my old Thunderbird icon links to nothing (should be a .exe file in a subfolder of the C:\Program Files folder), when I look up installed apps it tells me that Thunderbird is installed though I cannot find out where. So I dont know if it really is installed or not, or perhaps an update process deleted the old version but failed to install a new version due to security restrictions (I need to use an Administrator password to install new software on this work laptop).

If I have to reinstall Thunderbird, can I just connect it to my existing profile files, which I believe I have found (I have several profile folders but one of them has very recent file update dates)?

And then maybe I can disable the Mozilla Maintenance system, in case that is causing the problem?
